content.text:
Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Repo indkhan/Moneo. GitHub issue #268 (read `gh issue view 268`, AGENTS.md, and merged PR #266 for #237, which added the `unexplainedIgnoredFailure` lint selector and fixed swallowed failures in lib/, workflows/, server actions and route handlers; read how it names what handles a failure). Do two of the three parts in this PR:

1. Empty catches in app pages: `app/layout.tsx`, `app/setup/page.tsx`, `app/home-notices.tsx`, `app/import/[id]/review/page.tsx` (re-find with grep; there may be others in `app/**`). Extend the rule to `app/**` pages/components (in `eslint.config.mjs`; note later blocks override `no-restricted-syntax`, so combine selectors per file group, as the existing blocks do) and fix each case the way #266 did: handle it, surface it, or name the handler.
2. The ~40 `.catch(() => null)` (and similar `.catch(() => undefined/[]/{})`) that feed a value into validation. Recount with grep. Classify each in a table in the PR body: (a) the absent value is a legitimate expected outcome (e.g. a missing optional file), keep but make the intent explicit the #266 way; (b) it hides a real failure (database or network error looks like "no data"), return or record the real failure so the caller/UI sees it. Fix the (b) cases at the cause. If a fix changes what the owner sees, say so.

Leave part 3 (`lib/ai/use-voice-call.ts` dropping the call record when offline) out; it needs its own design. Say in the PR body that it remains.

Create branch `t3/issue-268-swallowed-failures` from origin/main. Commit in steps (rule extension + page fixes; catch-to-null fixes) with plain messages ending with "Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>". Tests: only for bugs that actually change behaviour (a failure that used to look like "no data"), testing the lib function, at most ~3 mocks. Before opening the PR, merge origin/main again. Run `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` yourself and quote their last lines. Tests use only the moneo-qa test backend; never the owner's backend (.env, Docker project `moneo`, port 3000). Never run `qa:reset` or `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`. Never kill a process you didn't start (verify by PID). Don't end your turn while a command is still running. No comments in code. Open the PR (body ends with "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)"), never merge it. Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>.

Deferred from PR #266 (#237), which added typed lint and fixed swallowed failures in lib/, workflows/, server actions and route handlers.

Still open:
- Empty catches in four app pages: `app/layout.tsx`, `app/setup/page.tsx`, `app/home-notices.tsx`, `app/import/[id]/review/page.tsx`. Extend the rule to `app/**` pages and fix them.
- `lib/ai/use-voice-call.ts` silently drops the call record save when offline (routed to `callRecordIsNotSavedWhenOffline`). It needs a retry-on-reconnect design.
- About 40 `.catch(() => null)` calls that feed a value into validation. Some hide real errors (database or network failures look like "no data"). Classify them, and return or record the real failures.

Part of #268 (parts 1 and 2). Part 3 (`lib/ai/use-voice-call.ts` dropping the call record when offline, `callRecordIsNotSavedWhenOffline`) is **not** in this PR; it needs its own retry-on-reconnect design and the issue stays open for it.

## 1. Empty catches in pages and components
`unexplainedIgnoredFailure` now also applies to `app/**` and `components/**` (`eslint.config.mjs`). It found the four pages named in the issue plus `app/money/investigations/page.tsx` and nine components. Each now names what handles it (`catch { rowIsShownAsUnreadable(); }`), or the catch was removed:
- The three polling callers (`ai-panel-dialog`, `chat-workspace` x2) no longer repeat `.catch(() => {})`; `usePolling` already ignores a rejected poll and retries on the next tick.
- The investigations page reports its background entity load through `awaitedLater`.

## 2. `.catch(() => null / [] / {} / false)`
Recounted: about 60 across `app/`, `components/`, `lib/`, `workflows/`, `desktop/`.

| Class | Sites | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Request/response body that is not JSON, then validated | 13 routes, `chatgpt.ts` token reply, `scalable/client.ts` | (a) a malformed body is the caller's mistake and gets 400/error. Now one named helper, `jsonBodyOrNull` (`lib/json-body.ts`) |
| Error-body reads on the client (`response.json().catch(() => ({}))`), `formData().catch`, voice `client_secrets` fetch, sync-on-open, analysis cancel, key check fetch | about 20 | (a) the next line turns "absent" into a message the owner sees. Unchanged |
| Missing optional files and process state in `desktop/src/backend/*`, `speech/model-store.ts` `config.json`, `speech/choose.ts` availability | 9 | (a) absence is the expected answer. Unchanged |
| Best-effort extras: speech name hints, Scalable quote name (falls back to the ISIN), organizer suggestions, chat title, settings updates section, price-change notes, server-side cancel before the local abort, no model means a rules-only organizer run, unreadable ChatGPT sign-in file means signed out, bank sync wait | 11 | (a) kept, now each names why (`speechWorksWithoutNameHints`, ...) |
| Already surfaced: `iou-review`, `recurring/review`, `pending-hold-panel`, `connected-banks` | 4 | (a) unchanged, they show an error already |
| Conversation title read: database error became "This chat has nothing to name yet." (400) | 1 | (b) now 500 "Could not read this chat. Try again." |
| `loadLoanPayoutIds` failure became "no loans", so loan payouts counted as spending and the organizer/anomaly agents treated them as spending | 7 (`dashboard-spending`, `insights/panel`, `home-review-actions`, `organization/page`, `organize/load`, `agent-runtime`, `home-review`) | (b) removed the catches; the failure now surfaces |

| `activeScalableConnection` failure looked like "no Scalable connection" in chat | 1 | (b) `awaitedLater`, so the chat answer fails with the error instead of silently dropping Scalable data |
